clauses.quote: DCPS shall collaborate with the WTU on the expansion of the Together Everyone Achieves More (TEAM) school-wide bonus program (originally defined by the December 17, 2007 Memorandum of Agreement between DCPS and the WTU) by broadening eligibility requirements based on a growth metric.
Teachers who receive an evaluation score of Minimally Effective shall be held on their current salary step.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who receive an evaluation score of Minimally Effective
clauses.notes: Passive voice; implicit agent is management holding salary step.

clauses.quote: Such Teachers who earn an evaluation scored of Effective or higher shall be immediately moved to the next step.
clauses.subject_text: Such Teachers who earn an evaluation scored of Effective or higher
clauses.notes: Passive voice; implicit agent is management promoting step.
